name: RubyOS 4.9.6
changelog: NEW: Ruby Virtual Machine Manager is built in - no Store install needed. App menu (Start) is now as wide as your display, and taller in fullscreen. Desktop icons auto-declutter on boot (no more stacked icons). Games: tapping a game hides the launcher and shows the game with a red X to go back - in every game. Runner: Easy/Medium/Hard, double obstacles, flying birds to duck under (Down/S to crouch), animated runner. Pong: Easy (AI only hits ~20%), Medium, Impossible. Pathweaver: full How to Play instructions. Terminal: Downloads/Desktop/Pictures/Documents now show your real Notes, Docs, Drive files and apps - use ls / tree / open.
